SiteHeader.description: An in-page target (`"#main"`) for a skip link, rendered first and shown on focus.

SiteHeader.name: sticky
SiteHeader.description: Stick to the top of its scroller (the page, or the nearest scrolling ancestor), on the sticky layer, `--r-marketing-site-header-top` below it (default 0).

Skeleton.name: label
Skeleton.description: Makes this skeleton the status for its group: `role="status"` plus this text, visually hidden.

Skeleton.name: lines
Skeleton.description: `text` only: number of lines; the last one is shorter, as real text runs out.

Skeleton.name: shape
Skeleton.description: - `text` (default): one line box of the inherited type (a 1em bar centred in 1lh), so it takes the space the text will; `lines` stacks several. - `block`: a rectangle you size with `className` (`h-chart`, `h-control`…). - `circle`: a disc, `size-control` by default (an avatar's stand-in).

Slider.name: form
Slider.description: The `<form>` the hidden input belongs to, by id.

Slider.name: formatOptions
Slider.description: Number formatting for the value, e.g.

Slider.name: formatValue
Slider.description: The value as words, for `aria-valuetext` and the bubble (e.g.

Slider.name: locale
Slider.description: BCP 47 locale for the value text, the bubble and numeric mark labels.

Slider.name: marks
Slider.description: Ticks on the track; a mark with a `label` also shows it under (beside) the track.

Slider.name: onValueChange
Slider.description: Every change, as it happens (each drag move, each key).

Slider.name: onValueCommit
Slider.description: Once per gesture that changed the value: on release, or on key up.

Slider.name: readOnly
Slider.description: Focusable and announced, but neither keys nor presses move it.

Slider.name: showValue
Slider.description: Shows the value in a bubble on the thumb while it is dragged or keyboard-focused.

Sparkline.name: format
Sparkline.description: Formats the numbers in the default summary.

Sparkline.name: label
Sparkline.description: What the line is, for its accessible name ("Requests per second, last 24h").

Sparkline.name: series
Sparkline.description: The entity's series slot (fixed per entity, never cycled).

Sparkline.name: summary
Sparkline.description: The spoken summary after the name.

Spinner.name: label
Spinner.description: Makes this spinner the status for what it waits on: `role="status"` plus this text, visually hidden, in the caller's language.

Splitter.name: keyboardStep
Splitter.description: How far an arrow key moves a separator, as a share (0–100).

Splitter.name: onSizesChange
Splitter.description: Every change, including each step of a drag.

Splitter.name: onSizesCommit
Splitter.description: Once per gesture (a drag's release, a key's release), with the sizes it left: persist these.

Splitter.name: orientation
Splitter.description: `horizontal`: panes side by side, separators upright (default).

Splitter.name: sizes
Splitter.description: Each pane's share (0–100) of the space, in pane order.

Splitter.Pane.name: collapsible
Splitter.Pane.description: It may collapse to nothing: Enter on its separator, Home, a drag past half its `min`.

Splitter.Pane.name: label
Splitter.Pane.description: Names the separator that resizes this pane ("Resize {label}").

Splitter.Pane.name: max
Splitter.Pane.description: Largest size: a share (0–100) or a token length.

Splitter.Pane.name: min
Splitter.Pane.description: Smallest open size: a share (0–100) or a token length.

Spotlight.name: as
Spotlight.description: The element or component to render.

Stack.name: as
Stack.description: The element or component to render.

Stack.name: gap
Stack.description: Space between children, from the UI scale.

Stagger.name: as
Stagger.description: The element or component to render.

Stagger.name: trigger
Stagger.description: `scroll`: play when the group first scrolls into view (as `ScrollReveal`, and only if it was below the fold).

StatCard.name: labels
StatCard.description: The tile's words, per instance (translate them, or say "faster" for latency).

StatCard.name: loading
StatCard.description: Skeleton value and delta while the first value loads.

StatCard.name: sentiment
StatCard.description: Is this change good news? "Error rate down" is `good`; "latency up" is `bad`.

StatCard.name: stale
StatCard.description: How old the value is, when it is old ("12 min old").

StatCard.name: status
StatCard.description: A status for the metric (a `StatusLabel`), under the delta.

StatCard.name: unit
StatCard.description: A unit set beside the value, smaller and quieter ("ms", "%").

StatusLabel.name: icon
StatusLabel.description: Replaces the tone's default glyph (decorative; the label names the state).

Stepper.name: label
Stepper.description: The list's name (the `nav` landmark's when steps can be selected).

Stepper.name: onStepSelect
Stepper.description: Makes steps selectable: by default every step before the current one (complete, skipped or in error) renders as a button that calls this.

Stepper.name: orientation
Stepper.description: `horizontal` (default): equal steps in a row, each label under its marker and a line from marker to marker; collapses to "Step 2 of 5 · Name" when its own container is narrow.

Stepper.Step.name: href
Stepper.Step.description: Renders a selectable step as a link (through the router config) instead of a button.

Stepper.Step.name: selectable
Stepper.Step.description: Overrides whether the step can be selected (default: a step before the current one).

Stepper.Step.name: status
Stepper.Step.description: `error` (it has problems to fix) or `skipped`; shown over its position.

Table.name: footer
Table.description: Content after the `<table>`, inside the scroll area: a bar that sticks to its bottom edge.

Table.name: stickyHeader
Table.description: Pin the head while the table's own scroll area scrolls.

Table.Caption.name: visuallyHidden
Table.Caption.description: Keep the caption as the table's accessible name without showing it.

Table.Cell.name: truncate
Table.Cell.description: One line with an ellipsis (default); the full text becomes `title`.

Table.Cell.name: wrap
Table.Cell.description: Text wraps onto more lines and the row grows to fit.

Table.HeaderCell.name: after
Table.HeaderCell.description: Rendered after the content, outside the sort button: a resize handle.

Table.HeaderCell.name: numeric
Table.HeaderCell.description: End-aligned and tabular; sized to its content (auto layout), so never truncated there.

Table.HeaderCell.name: onSort
Table.HeaderCell.description: Makes the header a sort button.

Table.HeaderCell.name: wrap
Table.HeaderCell.description: Text wraps onto more lines and the row grows to fit (prose-like values, a pricing grid).

Table.Row.name: index
Table.Row.description: The row's position in the DATA, from 0.

TagInput.name: caseSensitive
TagInput.description: Compare tags with case and diacritics when refusing duplicates.

TagInput.name: commitOnBlur
TagInput.description: Commit the typed tag when focus leaves the field.

TagInput.name: delimiter
TagInput.description: Splits typed and pasted text into tags; Enter always commits.

TagInput.name: name
TagInput.description: Submitted as one hidden input per tag.

TagInput.name: suggestions
TagInput.description: Offered in a list while typing; choosing one adds its `value`.

TagInput.name: validate
TagInput.description: A refusal message for a tag, or nothing to accept it.

Testimonial.name: logo
Testimonial.description: The company's logo, carrying its own accessible name (an ``, a labelled `svg`).

Testimonial.name: rating
Testimonial.description: A score shown with a read-only `Rating`, named by `labels.rating`.

Testimonial.name: source
Testimonial.description: The work the quote comes from (a case study, a review site), as a `<cite>`.

Testimonial.name: sourceUrl
Testimonial.description: The source's URL, as the blockquote's `cite` attribute.

Textarea.name: autosize
Textarea.description: Grow with the content instead of scrolling.

Textarea.name: maxRows
Textarea.description: With `autosize`: the most rows to grow to.

ThemeScript.name: nonce
ThemeScript.description: For a Content-Security-Policy that allows inline scripts by nonce.

ThemeScript.name: storageKey
ThemeScript.description: The `localStorage` key holding the saved preferences.

ThemeSwitcher.name: storageKey
ThemeSwitcher.description: The `localStorage` key holding the saved preferences.

ThemeSwitcher.name: themes
ThemeSwitcher.description: The themes to offer, in order.

ThemeSwitcher.name: variant
ThemeSwitcher.description: `segmented` (default) shows every theme; `select` suits a long list or a tight space.

TimeField.name: end
TimeField.description: Trailing adornment inside the frame (a `TimePicker`'s button).

TimeField.name: locale
TimeField.description: Segment order, digits, separators and day-period words.

TimeField.name: name
TimeField.description: Submits the value (`HH:mm`) in a hidden input.

TimeField.name: onValueChange
TimeField.description: The time the segments show, once it is complete and inside `min`/`max`; `null` while a segment is empty or the time is refused.

TimeField.name: step
TimeField.description: Minutes per arrow press on the minutes segment (and a `TimePicker`'s list stride).

TimeField.name: value
TimeField.description: A wall-clock time of day, 24-hour `HH:mm` (`HH:mm:ss` with `withSeconds`), or `null` for none.

TimeField.name: withSeconds
TimeField.description: Adds a seconds segment; the value becomes `HH:mm:ss`.

TimePicker.name: locale
TimePicker.description: Segment order, digits, separators and day-period words.

TimePicker.name: name
TimePicker.description: Submits the value (`HH:mm`) in a hidden input.

TimePicker.name: onValueChange
TimePicker.description: The time the segments show, once it is complete and inside `min`/`max`; `null` while a segment is empty or the time is refused.

TimePicker.name: step
TimePicker.description: The list's stride in minutes, and the minutes segment's arrows.

TimePicker.name: value
TimePicker.description: A wall-clock time of day, 24-hour `HH:mm` (`HH:mm:ss` with `withSeconds`), or `null` for none.

TimePicker.name: withSeconds
TimePicker.description: Adds a seconds segment; the value becomes `HH:mm:ss`.

Timeline.name: groupByDay
Timeline.description: Group under a sticky header per local day (default).

Timeline.name: hasMore
Timeline.description: More events exist beyond `events`: "Show more" (after any local pages) calls `onLoadMore`.

Timeline.name: headingLevel
Timeline.description: Day headers as headings at this level.

Timeline.name: label
Timeline.description: Accessible name: of the scroll region when `scrollable`, else of the list when ungrouped.

Timeline.name: loading
Timeline.description: First load: skeleton rows and one announced status, instead of the events.

Timeline.name: loadingMore
Timeline.description: `onLoadMore` is in flight: the button is busy and the list `aria-busy`.

Timeline.name: locale
Timeline.description: BCP 47 locale for every date, time and relative word.

Timeline.name: now
Timeline.description: The reference instant for relative times and Today/Yesterday.

Timeline.name: pageSize
Timeline.description: Show this many events, and that many more per "Show more" press.

Timeline.name: scrollable
Timeline.description: The timeline is its own scroller: a keyboard-focusable, labelled region the day headers stick to the top of.

ToastProvider.name: max
ToastProvider.description: Most toasts on screen; the oldest leaves first.

ToastProvider.name: position
ToastProvider.description: Corner of the viewport, in logical terms (`end` is the right in LTR).

ToggleGroup.name: name
ToggleGroup.description: Submitted as one hidden input per pressed value.

ToggleGroup.name: orientation
ToggleGroup.description: Inside a Toolbar, the toolbar's; elsewhere horizontal.

ToggleGroup.name: required
ToggleGroup.description: A single-choice group must have a choice (`aria-required`).

ToggleGroup.Item.name: value
ToggleGroup.Item.description: What the item contributes to the group's value.

Toolbar.name: overflow
Toolbar.description: Horizontal only: when the toolbar's own width cannot hold every item, the trailing ones that have a menu form move, in order, into a "More" menu at the end.

Toolbar.Item.name: menu
Toolbar.Item.description: What it becomes in the overflow menu: a `DropdownMenu.Item` (or `CheckboxItem`, `RadioGroup`…) doing the same thing.

Tooltip.name: arrow
Tooltip.description: Draw a pointer back at the trigger.

Tooltip.name: delay
Tooltip.description: Hover delay before opening, in ms.

Tooltip.name: disabled
Tooltip.description: Suppress the tooltip without unwrapping the trigger.

TreeView.name: checkedIds
TreeView.description: `multiple`: the fully checked ids, in tree order (a checked parent's unloaded children are implied).

TreeView.name: defaultExpandedIds
TreeView.description: Omitted: the ancestors of the current link (a nav tree opens down to the page you are on).

TreeView.name: error
TreeView.description: The whole tree failed: this message instead of rows.

TreeView.name: loadChildren
TreeView.description: Fetches a `hasChildren` node's children the first time it opens.

TreeView.name: loading
TreeView.description: The whole tree is loading: skeleton rows.

TreeView.name: onAction
TreeView.description: Enter or a press on an enabled node (after the selection changes, if it does).

TreeView.name: renderActions
TreeView.description: Controls at the end of a row (rename, delete).

TreeView.name: selectionMode
TreeView.description: - `none` (default): Enter or a press activates (a link follows; a parent opens or closes). - `single`: one node is selected (`aria-selected`); Enter, Space or a press selects. - `multiple`: a tri-state check per node (`aria-checked`); a parent checks everything under it and shows mixed when some of it is checked.

TreeView.name: virtualizeAbove
TreeView.description: Past this many visible rows, only the rows in view are mounted.

TreeView.Item.name: current
TreeView.Item.description: This link is the page being shown.

TreeView.Item.name: disabled
TreeView.Item.description: Not selectable, checkable or activatable; still focusable and expandable.

TreeView.Item.name: hasChildren
TreeView.Item.description: Children exist but are not loaded: expanding calls the tree's `loadChildren(id)`.

TreeView.Item.name: href
TreeView.Item.description: Makes the node a link (the `RouterProvider`'s link for an internal href).

TreeView.Item.name: id
TreeView.Item.description: Unique across the whole tree: selection, expansion and DOM ids key on it.

VirtualizedTable.name: bulkActions
VirtualizedTable.description: With `selectable`: a bar at the bottom of the table's frame while rows are selected, with the count, these actions and "Clear selection".

VirtualizedTable.name: caption
VirtualizedTable.description: A visible caption naming the table (or pass `aria-label`).

VirtualizedTable.name: columnsMenu
VirtualizedTable.description: A columns menu in the head's trailing cell: one checkbox per column (`required` columns stay).

VirtualizedTable.name: columnWidths
VirtualizedTable.description: Widths set by resizing, px by column id (controlled).

VirtualizedTable.name: empty
VirtualizedTable.description: What an empty table shows.

VirtualizedTable.name: error
VirtualizedTable.description: A failure message.

VirtualizedTable.name: filters
VirtualizedTable.description: The column filters' values, by column id (controlled).

VirtualizedTable.name: getRowKey
VirtualizedTable.description: A stable key per row: selection, expansion and React reconciliation all use it.

VirtualizedTable.name: getRowLabel
VirtualizedTable.description: The accessible name of a row's checkbox.

VirtualizedTable.name: loading
VirtualizedTable.description: Show skeleton rows (the head stays) and mark the table busy.

VirtualizedTable.name: loadingRows
VirtualizedTable.description: How many skeleton rows to draw while loading.

VirtualizedTable.name: manualFiltering
VirtualizedTable.description: The rows arrive already filtered (a server filters them); the table still shows and reports the filters.

VirtualizedTable.name: manualSorting
VirtualizedTable.description: The rows arrive already in `sort` order (a server sorts them).

VirtualizedTable.name: overscan
VirtualizedTable.description: Rows mounted beyond each edge of the viewport.

VirtualizedTable.name: resizableColumns
VirtualizedTable.description: A resize handle on every header (a column's `resizable: false` opts out): drag it, or focus it and use the arrows, Home and End.

VirtualizedTable.name: rowActions
VirtualizedTable.description: Per-row trailing actions (icon buttons, a menu).

VirtualizedTable.name: rows
VirtualizedTable.description: The holes of a sparse array are skipped; every other row keeps its index.

VirtualizedTable.name: selectable
VirtualizedTable.description: Adds a checkbox column with a select-all header (over every row the table presents: all filtered rows, or the page).

VirtualizedTable.name: stickyColumns
VirtualizedTable.description: Pin this many leading columns (and the expand and checkbox columns before them) to the inline-start edge while the table scrolls sideways.

VirtualizedTable.name: stickyHeader
VirtualizedTable.description: Pin the head while the table's own scroll area scrolls.

VirtualizedTable.name: striped
VirtualizedTable.description: Band every other body row.

VirtualizedTable.name: visibleColumns
VirtualizedTable.description: The ids of the columns shown (controlled).

VirtualizedTable.name: visibleRows
VirtualizedTable.description: How many rows the viewport shows; its height is that many `--ROW-H` plus the head, so it follows density and input.

Wizard.name: onComplete
Wizard.description: Finish was pressed (plain steps), or the form's `onSubmit` succeeded.

Wizard.Step.name: description
Wizard.Step.description: A line under the label in the Stepper.

Wizard.Step.name: fields
Wizard.Step.description: The form paths this step owns (`email`, `members`): only their errors block Next, and Next reveals them.

Wizard.Step.name: label
Wizard.Step.description: The step's name: its Stepper label and its heading.

Wizard.Step.name: optional
Wizard.Step.description: Offers "Skip" and says "Optional" in the Stepper.

Wizard.Step.name: validate
Wizard.Step.description: A check of the whole step once its fields pass, typically async ("are these people already members?").
